authority: Human requests freeze, causal audit, then smallest demonstrated repair and same-control rerun
hypotheses: A: acceleration, seed order, or multiplicity implementation error
B: covariance/rank/support changes under unrestricted line-label permutation create a mismatched reference distribution at this fixed design
C: wrap or original-position heterogeneity breaks exchangeability even if an iid null calibrates
D: sparse exposure creates estimation failures distinct from false flags
diagnostics: Use all existing 2000 synthetic result records for selection and aggregation; regenerate synthetic data with unchanged seeds only.

For each reading choose first complete flagged and first complete unflagged independent-null family, plus first complete flagged position-null family. Examine every class using all 10000 stored permutations: observed/permuted CMH ranks, residuals, support, stratum participation and p-values. Deterministic selection, no outcome-selected method tuning.
Compare analytic fixed-design iid mean/covariance (conditioning on actual exposures and fixed labels) with CMH covariance; quantify false signals in covariance-nullspace if any.
Compare ranks/information and synthetic p-value diagnostics across fixed labels versus permutation distribution; use exact reference engine checks.

Only after audit receipt freezes cause evidence, define minimal repair with explicit null/estimand and unchanged thresholds, labels, masks, original support gates and scenarios. Do not silently redefine nulls.

Repair rerun must use same 5 scenarios, 200 replicates each, H/F, original data seeds and at least10000 null draws; retain original results and paired summaries. New calibration requires same full-estimability, Wilson upper<=.05 and positive>=.80. No post-result further repair in this attempt.
non_goals: No actual manuscript feature counts or prevalences
No scientific negative result from failed/undefined controls
No outcome join or vault access
No label/rater choices, support relaxation, bootstrap rescue or alpha_V spending
decision: Diagnostic only. A new method cannot release outcomes automatically.
